## `neuro.int8Array.join`

Instance method on `Int8Array.prototype`.

> Adds all the elements of an array separated by the specified separator string.

## Signatures

```ts
join(input: { int8Array: <receiver>; separator?: string; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Int8Array.prototype.join` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.

## Example

<Code

  code={atob("")}
  wrap
